scope: Initial verified public source extracts for issues #95–#101, not complete research

patterns.name: Question filtering and saved filters
patterns.definition: Combine exam attributes, keyword and exclusions; make the applied criteria visible and removable.
patterns.guardrail: Do not confuse employer, examining board, position, exam year and discipline. Do not assume unseen filter states.
patterns.tests: Given a saved filter, restore the same criteria; verify zero results and clearing a single criterion.
patterns.classification: Source-backed synthesis; proposed acceptance test, not executed product validation

patterns.name: Question notebook and saved sets
patterns.definition: Distinguish a selected question set from a live filter and a scored attempt.
patterns.guardrail: The documentation describes creating notebooks; it is not proof of how all mobile or offline states work.
patterns.tests: Check set membership, duplicates, empty set, and changes to source questions.
patterns.classification: Source-backed synthesis; proposed acceptance test, not executed product validation

patterns.name: Retrieval and distributed practice
patterns.definition: Plan opportunities to recall information and distribute study across time, rather than only reread material.
patterns.guardrail: Evidence for learning techniques is not validation of a particular app or scheduling algorithm; retention and transfer differ.
patterns.tests: Compare delayed recall using equivalent items and record exposure, study time and attrition.
patterns.classification: Source-backed synthesis; proposed acceptance test, not executed product validation

patterns.name: Assessment item and test interoperability
patterns.definition: Separate assessment item, test, response and result; use QTI for portable structured assessments where required.
patterns.guardrail: Interoperability does not imply validity or calibrated difficulty. Do not apply IRT without calibration data.
patterns.tests: Round-trip an original fictional item and check response identifiers, scoring and result versioning.
patterns.classification: Source-backed synthesis; proposed acceptance test, not executed product validation

patterns.name: Typed knowledge objects and relations
patterns.definition: Model reusable connected objects rather than forcing every record into a file hierarchy.
patterns.guardrail: Documentation establishes the object-oriented concept, not all interaction states or historical app decisions.
patterns.tests: Check stable identity, reference integrity, missing target and reversible type changes.
patterns.classification: Source-backed synthesis; proposed acceptance test, not executed product validation

patterns.name: Typed nodes and fields
patterns.definition: Use explicit type and field definitions for structured nodes; views can present the same data in different contexts.
patterns.guardrail: Do not assume inheritance, sync or deletion semantics without feature-specific evidence.
patterns.tests: Check required/optional fields, type changes and stale references in original examples.
patterns.classification: Source-backed synthesis; proposed acceptance test, not executed product validation

patterns.name: Annotation anchor resilience
patterns.definition: Separate annotation body, target and selector. Text quotes with context can help reanchor; positions are vulnerable to content edits.
patterns.guardrail: Never silently reattach an ambiguous selection; avoid copying restricted text into exported annotations.
patterns.tests: Test version change, repeated quotes, no match, changed offsets and explicit unresolved state.
patterns.classification: Source-backed synthesis; proposed acceptance test, not executed product validation

patterns.name: Accessible component behavior contract
patterns.definition: Define semantics, input behavior, keyboard, focus and states separately from visual tokens.
patterns.guardrail: Library accessibility claims do not establish product-level conformance; verify actual composition.
patterns.tests: Exercise keyboard, pointer and touch; test disabled, busy and invalid states and accessible names.
patterns.classification: Source-backed synthesis; proposed acceptance test, not executed product validation

patterns.name: ARIA widget interaction patterns
patterns.definition: Select the matching widget semantics and keyboard interaction contract; prefer native elements where appropriate.
patterns.guardrail: APG is implementation guidance, not a substitute for WCAG conformance testing.
patterns.tests: Validate accessible role/name/state, focus sequence and restoration, and screen-reader operation.
patterns.classification: Source-backed synthesis; proposed acceptance test, not executed product validation

patterns.name: Data visualization palette semantics
patterns.definition: Choose categorical colors for unordered categories, sequential for magnitude, and diverging for a meaningful center.
patterns.guardrail: Color must not be the only cue; distinguish missing values from zero and category from status.
patterns.tests: Check legend/labels, contrast, textual alternative and meaningful ordering with original sample data.
patterns.classification: Source-backed synthesis; proposed acceptance test, not executed product validation
